table.name: singer
table.purpose: One row per person. Despite the table name 'singer', the data (names like Christy Walton, Alice Walton, Gina Rinehart, Iris Fontbona — known billionaires — plus citizenship and net worth) strongly suggests these are wealthy individuals, not singers. The table is referenced by 'song' via Singer_ID, so it serves as the artist/person master table in this schema. The name/wealth mismatch is unresolved: the table may be misnamed or the data mislabeled.

Birth_Year.name: Birth_Year
Birth_Year.description: Year of birth of the person (1940-1962). Stored as double but integer-valued.

Citizenship.name: Citizenship
Citizenship.description: Country of citizenship of the person (e.g., United States, Australia, Chile, France, Germany).

Name.name: Name
Name.description: Full name of the person. Unique per row. Note: values are names of well-known billionaires (Waltons, Gina Rinehart, Iris Fontbona), inconsistent with a table of singers.

Net_Worth_Millions.name: Net_Worth_Millions
Net_Worth_Millions.description: Net worth of the person in millions (range 12.7 to 30.0).

Singer_ID.name: Singer_ID
Singer_ID.description: Primary key of the table; unique identifier for each person. Referenced by song.Singer_ID (many songs to one singer).

table.name: song
table.purpose: A catalog of songs, each with its title, performing singer, sales figures, and highest chart position reached. Each row represents one song.

Highest_Position.name: highest_chart_position
Highest_Position.description: The highest (best) chart position the song reached; 1 means it hit number one. Values are small positive integers (1 or 3 here).

Sales.name: sales
Sales.description: Total sales of the song, in units/copies (values range from 261,000 to 1,094,000).

Singer_ID.name: singer_id
Singer_ID.description: Foreign key to singer.Singer_ID, identifying the singer who performed the song (many songs to one singer).

Song_ID.name: song_id
Song_ID.description: Primary key; unique identifier for each song.

Title.name: title
Title.description: The song's title (e.g. 'Cha Cha Slide', 'Do They Know It's Christmas').
